verdict.rationale: Ashby presents itself as an all-in-one platform combining ATS, CRM, scheduling and analytics. Its MCP docs show candidates, applications, interviews, notes, feedback and emails all live as records in the system, which implies candidate data is centralized. However, nothing in the evidence describes a single unified candidate profile view, and several elements of the story are not shown at all. Missing for 10: explicit unified candidate profile documentation, resume storage on the profile, email threads linked to the candidate record, activity history/timeline, consent status tracking, independent hands-on corroboration.
